scope: Theorem B.5 (Guth–Katz, higher richness) of the manuscript “The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture” (preprints/The-higher-dimensional-Erdos-distinct-distances-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 166 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37f6355365a18510), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 93. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let L be L distinct lines in R3, with at most B0 in any affine plane. For every integer k ≥ 3, the number Rk of points lying on at least k lines satisfies Rk ≤ C L3/2 k2 + LB0 k3 + L k ! . There is no assumption about lines on quadrics in this theorem.
